pairs.subject: deployment-contract
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:10 The console's web build is put into a local Tauri desktop bundle and talks only to a localhost daemon, so no hosting platform builds or serves it; I searched apps/console (gitignore-respecting) for vercel, netlify, wrangler, Cache-Control and deploy and found nothing, so the subject's precondition (deploying through a hosting platform) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:9 The only second builder is the Tauri CLI, and it runs the package's own `pnpm build` task. No hosted builder exists that could resolve differently.
apps/console/vite.config.ts:10 Vite emits hashed assets, but they are served from the embedded app bundle. No host sends cache-lifetime headers to clients.
apps/console/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:8 There is a local dev server and nothing else: no preview or production environment ladder for the console.
apps/console/src-tauri/Cargo.toml:8 Nothing deploys the console on push, so there is no deploy/verify race to couple.
